scenario: Verify that Client Representative can view Resident Overview with correct breadcrumb navigation
description: Validate that the Resident Overview page loads with the breadcrumb Home > Residences > Residents > Resident Name for an onboarded resident.
preconditions: Client Representative is logged in. A resident record exists and is onboarded.

steps.name: Navigate to Resident Overview
steps.instruction: Navigate to the Residences module, select Residents, and click a resident.
steps.expected_result: The Resident Overview page loads for the selected resident.

steps.name: Verify Breadcrumb Navigation
steps.instruction: Observe the breadcrumb at the top of the page.
steps.expected_result: Breadcrumb displays Home Icon > Residences > Residents > Resident Name.

scenario: Verify that Overview tab is selected by default on Resident Overview page
description: Ensure the Overview tab is active when the Resident Overview page loads and the other tabs are not selected.
preconditions: Client Representative navigates to the Resident Overview page.

steps.name: Check Default Tab Selection
steps.instruction: Observe the tab bar on the Resident Overview page.
steps.expected_result: Overview is highlighted as the selected tab. Calendar, Notes, and Activity Feed are visible but not selected.

scenario: Verify that Resident profile header displays required resident information
description: Confirm the profile header displays profile picture or initials, resident name, unit details, contact number, and email for a resident with complete data.
preconditions: User is on Resident Overview for a resident with profile, unit, contact, and email data.

steps.name: Observe Resident Header
steps.expected_result: The header displays profile picture or initials, resident name, unit name/number, applicable floor/block/tower information, contact number, and email.

scenario: Verify that About Resident card hides fields without values
description: Validate that Personal Details and Additional Info display only fields with configured values and do not show empty placeholders.
preconditions: User is on Resident Overview. The resident has Name and Move In Date but no Phone, Email, DOB, Gender, ID, or document values.

steps.name: Open About Resident
steps.instruction: Locate and expand the About Resident card.
steps.expected_result: The card displays the available Name and Move In Date values. Fields without values are hidden and are not shown with placeholders.
